post.summary: Estimate image credits without submitting a generation
post.description: Validates image parameters and returns the credits that a generation request would reserve. It does not create a task.

The model field uses platform/model and selects the upstream platform. Use application/json for text-only generation or multipart/form-data with image/image[] for reference-image generation. Both forms return a durable task immediately; polling uses only the task ID. Results are URL-only.

413.description: Reference image exceeds the configured size limit

415.description: Reference image type is not PNG, JPEG, or WebP

post.description: The model field uses platform/model and selects the upstream platform. No-reference requests use application/json and reference-media requests use multipart/form-data. The API returns a durable task immediately; polling uses only the task ID.

x-generation-modes.name: No reference
x-generation-modes.rule: Do not send image, start_frame, end_frame, video, or audio.

x-generation-modes.name: Image reference
x-generation-modes.rule: Cannot be combined with start_frame or end_frame. Adobe Seedance accepts up to 9 images, Adobe Veo and Kling accept up to 3. Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 30 images.

x-generation-modes.name: Start/end frame

model_exceptions.grok-imagine-1.5: start_frame is required and end_frame is unsupported

x-generation-modes.rule: end_frame requires start_frame. Frames cannot be combined with ordinary images, videos, or audio. Grok Imagine 1.5 requires start_frame and rejects end_frame.

x-generation-modes.name: Video reference
x-generation-modes.rule: Adobe Seedance accepts up to 3 files totaling 15 seconds. Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 10 files totaling 30.2 seconds. Cannot be combined with start_frame or end_frame.

x-generation-modes.name: Audio reference
x-generation-modes.rule: Adobe Seedance accepts up to 3 files totaling 15 seconds and requires an image or video. Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 10 files totaling 30.2 seconds. MiniMax H3 requires an ordinary image.

post.summary: Estimate video credits without submitting a generation
post.description: Validates video parameters and returns the credits that a task would reserve. It does not create a task.
The model field uses platform/model and selects the upstream platform. Adobe currently has no audio adapter, so audio uses model=leonardo/model. Polling uses only the returned task ID.

post.summary: Create an image through Chat Completions compatibility
post.description: Uses the final user message as the image prompt. The model field uses platform/model. Accepts text and one Base64 image. Set stream=true for SSE.

202.description: Synchronous wait expired; continue polling the returned task

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required unique value for one paid business operation. Reuse it only when retrying the identical request body. A missing value returns idempotency_key_required; a value over 255 characters returns idempotency_key_too_long.

GenerationProvider.description: Selects the upstream platform at task creation or estimation time. Polling and cancellation use only the task ID.

ImageSize.description: auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT. gpt-image-2 requires Leonardo width/height enums, ratio <= 3:1, and 655360..8294400 pixels. gpt-image-2 on model=adobe/model exposes Adobe 1K, 2K, and 4K square tiers. Nano Banana 2/Pro and nano-banana-2 on model=adobe/model use the enumerated 1K/2K/4K size table. Seedream 5.0 Pro accepts custom integer edges from 768 through 2048 inclusive; its standard UI presets are enumerated in x-model-rules.

cost.two_k_condition: width>=2016 and height>=1153, or width>=1153 and height>=2016

ImageQuantity.description: Number of images returned by this gateway in one request.

ImageRequest.description: Strict public image DTO. Leonardo-native prompt_enhance/style_ids, internal references, and Nano Banana 2 video_reference_base are not exposed and are rejected as unknown fields.

quality.description: gpt-image-2 only. auto is normalized to low by this gateway; Leonardo's native schema default is MEDIUM.

ImageEstimateRequest.description: Image pricing inputs only. size accepts auto or a model-valid WIDTHxHEIGHT; quality is accepted only for gpt-image-2; n is the requested image quantity.

quality.description: gpt-image-2 only; auto is normalized to low. Other models reject quality.

size.description: Normalized exact WIDTHxHEIGHT used for the estimate.

quality.description: Normalized GPT quality; omitted for models without a quality parameter.

estimated_tokens.description: unit_tokens multiplied by quantity; this is the reservation amount.

pricing_anchor.description: Internal pricing bucket used to select the active rule.

quality_multiplier.description: GPT Image 2 multiplier: low=1, medium=8.833, high=35.167.

cost_parameters.description: Request fields that can change the estimate for this model.

AsyncImageRequest.description: URL-only asynchronous image DTO. Leonardo-native fields not listed here are rejected.

quality.description: gpt-image-2 only. auto is normalized to low by this gateway.

response_format.description: Async tasks always return URLs; b64_json is unavailable.

ImageReferenceRequest.description: URL-only asynchronous multipart image-reference request. Leonardo-native seed, prompt_enhance, style_ids, and Nano Banana 2 video references are not exposed.

quality.description: gpt-image-2 only. auto is normalized to low by this gateway.

response_format.description: Async tasks always return URLs; b64_json is unavailable.

KlingO3OmniSize.description: Exact Leonardo output dimensions. Each size is tied to the 720p, 1080p, or 2160p price tier.

KlingO3OmniDimensionRules.description: Enforces the Kling O3 Omni size-to-resolution price tier mapping when both fields are present.

LeonardoCurrentVideoRequest.description: Current Leonardo video catalog. Exact duration, size, and resolution combinations are validated by the gateway per model.

size.description: Model-specific output dimensions; use the size/resolution combinations shown by the model catalog.

LeonardoCurrentVideoEstimateRequest.description: Cost estimate for the current Leonardo video catalog. The gateway applies the model-specific active price rule.

reference_mode.description: Selects the exact Adobe BKS workflow price.

KlingO3OmniVideoEstimateRequest.description: Kling O3 Omni estimate. When has_video_reference=true, duration is the reference-video duration used for pricing; it must be 3-10 seconds and the selected tier cannot be 2160p.

VideoReferenceRequest.description: Multipart request with model-supported reference fields; there is no mode field. Gemini Omni Flash accepts up to five ordinary images. Kling O3 Omni accepts up to seven images, start/end frames, or one video plus up to four images. Adobe reference combinations remain documented under their Adobe model IDs. start_frame is required for frame input, end_frame is optional where supported and requires start_frame, and frame fields are exclusive with ordinary image/video/audio references.

GeminiOmniFlashReferenceRequest.description: Gemini Omni Flash image-to-video reference request. Up to five ordinary image files are accepted.

AdobeVeo31FastReferenceRequest.description: Adobe Firefly frame-reference request. start_frame is required; end_frame is optional.

AdobeKling30OmniReferenceRequest.description: Adobe Firefly Kling 3.0 Omni accepts up to three ordinary images or a start frame with optional end frame. Native audio is fixed off.

AdobeSeedanceStandardReferenceRequest.description: Adobe Seedance 2.0 accepts up to 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio files, with no more than 12 combined reference items. Frames are exclusive with all other media; audio requires an image or video.

AdobeSeedanceFastReferenceRequest.description: Adobe Seedance 2.0 Fast uses the same reference limits as Seedance 2.0 and exposes only 480p and 720p sizes.

KlingO3OmniReferenceRequest.description: Kling O3 Omni multipart request. Use up to seven ordinary images, start_frame with optional end_frame, or one reference video with up to four ordinary images. Frame guidance is exclusive with ordinary images and video. Reference video duration must be within 0.05 seconds of the integer duration field.

video.description: One MP4, MOV, or WebM reference. Duration 3-10.05 seconds; each edge 720-2160 pixels; 2160p output is unsupported. The duration field must match the uploaded file within 0.05 seconds.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: The final user message becomes an image prompt. Its combined text is limited by the selected image model and is rejected before task admission when too long.

status.description: Stable gateway lifecycle status. Internal worker and upstream phases are not exposed.

progress.description: Gateway progress. Leonardo does not provide a generation percentage while processing, so this value may remain 0 until a terminal state.

queue_position.description: Position in the AIV2API local account queue; present only while queued
